difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a morphism between sheaves on a site induces a natural commutative diagram of localizations of the topos, with the pullback and the lower shriek described by the displayed formulas (statement lines 7764-7789). The proof is a short but complete derivation: the descriptions of the two functors are those of the companion localization lemma (proof lines 7792-7794); the identity between the lower shrieks is immediate from their description as forgetful functors (proof lines 7795-7797); and the identities for the pullback and pushforward follow by adjointness (proof lines 7798-7800). The non-formal content is the identification of the functors from their descriptions. The claim is H1: a short derivation with each input named.
